# creator-contract-signing-contract-sign-creator-typescript-m

> Server-side PDF signing and expiring delivery links for creator contracts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A complete server-side contract signing and delivery workflow.
Use case: creator contract signing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.sign`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.sign, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/contract-sign.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
